text:
rachel: Quick heads-up — launching paid push for the "Scaling LLMs" webinar next Tue. Draft plan attached (search + retarget + creative refresh). Can someone sanity-check budgets, lead routing, and top-line KPI targets?
omar: On creative — do we have two speaker images to A/B or just one? landing page has variant B that shortens form. recommend A/B on hero.
devin: Budget looks fine. Suggest front-load ~60% of spend first 48h to hit registration momentum, then scale down to sustained pace. Example: $1,500/day days 1–2, $700/day thereafter. retarget bids +25% vs search.
sophia: Routing note — leads should go to SFDC queue "webinar-nurture" + tag source=google. make sure we pass utm params (utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_mar). Also add lead_type=paid_webinar.
ads-bot: Campaign created (draft): id=camp_98765 status=paused owner=@rachel -- remember to set conversion action before unpause.
rachel: thanks. Creative refresh: need 2 new headlines and 1 animated gif for retarget. keeping existing deck of screenshots for social.
omar: Proposed headlines: 1) "Scaling LLMs: Cost & Latency Playbook" 2) "How We Cut Token Cost by 3x — Live" 3) backup: "LLM Inference at Scale: Lessons from Prod" (pick top 2). gif idea: quick 6s loop of latency graph + CTA.
devin: Targeting notes: search keyword set (broad-match-modified): +llm +inference +model +deployment; phrase-match for "model serving". retarget window = 14 days, frequency cap 3/day. exclude converters 7d.
sophia: Benchmarks to watch first 48h: CTR >= 2.5%, CPC trending <$3, CVR >= 1.5% (registrations), target CPA $40–$55. if CPC > $3.50 or CPA > $70 after 48h, throttle and refresh creatives.
rachel: great. tracker for experiments: use the campaign naming convention so we can attribute ABs: REDW_WEBINAR_2026_MAR_search_v1 / _rt_v1, etc.
rachel: google bulk-edit snippet for ops (paste into editor):
```
Campaign,DailyBudget,BiddingStrategy,Status
"REDW_WEBINAR_2026_MAR_search_v1",1500,MaximizeConversions,Enabled
"REDW_WEBINAR_2026_MAR_rt_v1",700,TargetCPA(45),Paused
```

devin: small ask — make sure pixel fires on CTA confirmation and form hidden field "lead_source=paid_search" present. i'll add a smoky test to validate.
sophia: i'll update SFDC mapping & create automation to tag as "paid-webinar" and kick off nurture sequence (email1 at 0h, email2 at 24h).
rachel: ok pulling this into the launch binder. i'll unpause once conversion action is set and creatives uploaded. thanks all :thumbsup:
omar: quick follow — timeline for creative upload? can we have assets by EOD tomorrow?
rachel: yes EOD tomorrow target. i'll ping if anything slips.
ads-bot: Reminder: conversion action missing for camp_98765 -- set before unpause.
